verdict_text:
YES

The script loads both shards via the index, drops every tensor of blocks 2, 6, 10, 14, and renumbers survivors by their original order (old 3→2, 4→3, 5→4, 7→5, 8→6, 9→7, 11→8, 12→9, 13→10, 15→11), keeping the rest of each name and the tensor object unchanged. Non-block tensors pass through untouched. Before writing it asserts the surviving block indices are exactly {0..11} (which also rules out any block 12–15) and that the total is 86 tensors, so failures exit non-zero with no output written. The result is a single `out/T1/model.safetensors`.
